sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Kérem (with -m) is the definite form of kér, used when 'it' is something specific already mentioned, like a bill: Igen, kérem = 'Yes, I'd like it (the bill)'.

items.english: Yes, please. / Yes, I'd like it.

sections.content: Compare kérem here to kérek elsewhere: kérek asks for something new and general, kérem confirms something specific already on the table.
